headers.comment: The auth token lives in localStorage, so a single XSS anywhere in the app would exfiltrate it. This policy is what stops injected markup from loading or reaching an attacker-controlled origin. 'unsafe-inline' on style-src is required by the inline style props still present in the components; remove it once those are migrated to classes. connect-src must list the API origin — update it if VITE_API_URL changes.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' https://accounts.google.com https://alcdn.msauth.net; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com data:; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https://*.onrender.com https://accounts.google.com https://login.microsoftonline.com wss://*.onrender.com; frame-src https://accounts.google.com https://login.microsoftonline.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
